name: Kurata Eiji
source: Sayuri's husband and Miki's father. He is director of Kurata hospital and got married to Sayuri who is daughter of another rival hospital's director when the two merged together due to financial problem. Unlike his strict wife, he is carefree and sweet to his daughter Miki.
